svg.title: Frostbite pinout: Seeed XIAO RP2040 wiring, 3x3 matrix, OLED header and board map
svg.text: Seeed XIAO RP2040, component side up, USB-C at the top. Nets from design.json; QMK keyboard.json and config.h use the same pins.
Column → switch → 1N4148 → row. Diode cathode (bar) toward the row.
Shaded = agent keys, white = command keys. Encoder push not wired.
Board map · top view of the PCB
Encoder: A, C, B row faces
Header order: GND · VCC · SCL · SDA
3V3 → OLED VCC · GND common to everything
XIAO 5V and D6 are not connected. Encoder push is not wired.
The pad has no lights. All status is on the OLED.
The XIAO sits under the PCB on its castellated pads,
so from above the board its pin columns are mirrored.
